item.title: 01 · From Signal to Fill
item.description: When market conditions are matched, does extra delay between a trading decision and its order's outcome cost price or fills? Verdict: Inconclusive. Both primary tests are null, by design. A taker acting on order book imbalance paid 0.52 to 0.66 bps by 500 ms on the test days, an upper end.
